Implementation of lib/config.sh; it [[fb-lib-config|serves|lib/config.sh is the concrete file the settings bead names.]]. It defines config_file (${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/macacfs/config), config_registry (the key|default|description table for newproj.github, newproj.ru and newproj.projects_dir), config_validate (off|private|public, on|off, an absolute path or empty; unknown keys are refused), config_get_raw, config_effective (env MACACFS_<KEY> > file > default, optionally with its source), config_set and config_unset (rewrite through a mktemp file in the same directory, chmod 600, mv), config_list, config_usage and config_main, the 'macacfs config list|get|set|unset' verb. It avoids associative arrays so it also loads under /bin/bash 3.2. bin/macacfs and lib/newproj/newproj_remote.sh source it, so its config_effective [[fb-lib-newproj-remote-impl|couples-with|newproj_remote.sh reads newproj.* through config_effective, so the key names and value spellings here are its contract.]]. Its keys, values and precedence are documented by [[fb-readme-impl|relates-to|README.md's Settings section lists exactly the three keys and value sets config_validate accepts.]].
